ResearchProjectDef.label: eltex augmentics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Weaponized eltex implants: emitter assemblies that couple to the nervous system and convert psychic sensitivity into directed force, and the elemental cores that retune them.

ResearchProjectDef.label: psychic vision induction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Eltex resonance chambers that project engineered sensory experiences directly into a mind. The recreational applications are obvious; other applications are a further research project.

ResearchProjectDef.label: traumatic psionic awakening
ResearchProjectDef.description: Remove the vision inducer's safety limiters and replace reverie with engineered horror. Sufficient psychological trauma can crack a dormant mind open to the psychic field — a fact this research does not so much discover as decide to use.
